title: Ai2 blog post on OlmoEarth Platform inference scaling (not a launch)
reason: Carried over from cycle 3 as "Allen Institute for AI launches OlmoEarth platform" (dedup-check cleared, not yet investigated). On investigation the working title was wrong: the OlmoEarth Platform itself launched in November 2025 (Businesswire, GeekWire, other coverage all dated 2025-11-04). The 28 July 2026 Hugging Face post is a technical blog write-up of an infrastructure scaling run (a wildfire-risk inference job across ~19,600 CPUs / 994 GPUs, 155x speedup), not a new product or capability launch. Single-source (Ai2's own blog), no independent press pickup found for this specific post. Does not clear the newsworthiness/independence bar as a standalone story; dropped rather than published under a corrected headline.
watch: Independent press coverage of this specific scaling milestone, if any outlet picks it up
notes: 2026-07-29 c4: dropped after WebFetch of primary source + WebSearch showed the "launches" framing was inaccurate (product predates this post by ~9 months).
